questions.title: Candidate email-verification link details
questions.question: Candidates verify their email by an emailed link before first login (decided). How long is the link valid, how often can it be resent, what does the link page do, and what happens when someone signs up with an email that is already registered?

options.label: 24 h link, no auto sign-in
options.description: 24 h single-use link; resend at most 1/min and 5/day; link page shows 'Email verified' + Sign in; first login goes to onboarding; existing email gets the same 'check your inbox' screen (no account enumeration); an email change needs re-verification.

options.label: Same, but auto sign-in
options.description: As (a), but opening the link signs the user in directly.

options.label: 48 h link, explicit duplicate error
options.description: 48 h link and a visible 'This email is already registered' error.

questions.decisionNote: Decision: 'Candidates must verify their email (emailed link) before first login' - link only, no 6-digit email code (settles CAN-Q7's sub-question). Audits differ on resend limits (SHR-Q5: 1/min and 5/day; CAN-Q7: 5/hour). Recommend 1/min and 5/day: protects the Gmail SMTP daily sending quota.

questions.title: When recruiters enter the emailed code
questions.question: Recruiters verify their work email with an emailed code (decided). Is the code required straight after sign-up, or at onboarding step 4 as today (where they can sign in before verifying)?

options.label: Right after sign-up
options.description: Code entered immediately after sign-up; onboarding continues only after it; step 4 handles only the phone.

options.label: At onboarding step 4 (today)
options.description: Recruiter can sign in and resume onboarding unverified; the email code is entered at step 4 with the phone code.

questions.decisionNote: Decision: Gmail SMTP sends the 'recruiter onboarding email verification code'. Conflict: SHR-Q6 recommends recruiters verify by an emailed LINK before first login (like candidates); the decision says CODE, so options keep the code. REC-RQ-8 recommends (a): no unverified sign-ins, consistent with candidates.

questions.title: Recruiter phone verification
questions.question: Recruiter onboarding verifies the phone number, and phone codes are shown on screen with no SMS (decided). Where in the flow is the code done, and what does the admin see?

options.label: On-screen code at step 4
options.description: Server generates a random 6-digit code per request, shows it on screen and verifies it at step 4; admin review shows 'Phone confirmed on screen (no SMS)'.

options.label: On-screen code when phone entered
options.description: Same mechanism, done at step 1 right where the phone number is typed.

questions.decisionNote: Decision: 'Phone codes on screen' (no SMS). Conflict: ADM-Q63 recommends collecting the recruiter phone unverified (option C) or adding an SMS provider (option B); both contradict the on-screen code decision. REC-RQ-9 and SHR-Q6 recommend the on-screen code. The fixed demo code 123456 goes away either way.

questions.title: Verification code rules
questions.question: What rules apply to the email and phone codes (length, expiry, attempts, resend), and can one phone number be verified on more than one account?

options.label: 6 digits, 10 min, one account
options.description: 6-digit code, 10-minute expiry, max 5 wrong attempts, resend after 60 s (max 5/hour), a 'Resend code' link, changing email/phone resets verification, phone stored in E.164 with a country-code input, one phone per account.

options.label: Same, phone reusable
options.description: As (a), but the same phone may be verified on several accounts.

options.label: Owner sets other limits
options.description: The owner provides different numbers.

questions.decisionNote: REC-RQ-10 and CAN-Q40 agree; CAN-Q40 adds 'one phone number per account'.

questions.title: Signing in on the wrong portal

options.label: Sign in and redirect

options.label: Reject with a hint
options.description: Refuse with 'This is a {role} account, sign in here' plus a link.

options.label: One shared sign-in page
options.description: Merge candidate and recruiter sign-in; role choice only at sign-up.

questions.decisionNote: Decision: one role per account; candidate and recruiter sign up separately; header workspace switch removed. REC-RQ-14 and SHR-Q4 both recommend (a).

questions.title: Password rules

options.label: 24 h token, no revocation

questions.title: Login brute-force protection

options.description: No protection in v1.
